a: **Lens formula:** 1/f = 1/v − 1/u (sign convention matters). f = focal length, u = object distance, v = image distance.
**Specific heat capacity:** Q = mcΔθ. Heat energy = mass × specific heat × temperature change. Unit of c: J/kg°C.
**Boyle's law:** At constant temperature, P₁V₁ = P₂V₂. Pressure and volume are inversely proportional.
**Charles's law:** At constant pressure, V₁/T₁ = V₂/T₂. Temperature must be in Kelvin (K = °C + 273).
**Ideal gas law:** PV = nRT. P pressure, V volume, n moles, R gas constant, T absolute temperature.
**Half-life:** Time for half the radioactive nuclei to decay. After n half-lives, remaining fraction = (1/2)^n.
**Mechanical advantage:** MA = load / effort. Velocity ratio VR = distance moved by effort / distance moved by load. Efficiency = (MA/VR) × 100%.
**Hooke's law:** F = ke. Force proportional to extension (within elastic limit). k = spring constant.
**Coulomb's law:** F = k q₁q₂ / r². Force between two point charges. k ≈ 9×10⁹ N·m²/C².
**Transformer:** Vs/Vp = Ns/Np. Secondary/primary voltage equals turns ratio. Ideal: Pp = Ps so Ip/Is = Ns/Np.
